comment: The geometry of runs-page.html, worked out by hand from its fixed heights: the body starts under the 100px header; the 50x30 drawing is too small to count; #notes runs to the next h2 (#after), past its h3; #code exempts its first open details whole (6500..7650: a 50px summary, two 500px fences and a 100px lead-in), because its fences together are 1000px, over 900px; the closed details before it is passed over and adds only its 50px summary (its 1200px fence is not shown); #gone is not on the page; #short's open details holds 300px of code, under 900px, so nothing there is exempt.
